verdict.rationale: Consensus's own llms.txt and llms-full.txt say it offers an MCP server alongside its REST API to power agent workflows. They also name one MCP-specific parameter (`exclude_preprints=true`), so the capability is first-party and direct. However, the evidence is limited to brief machine-readable summaries with no connection or setup documentation, so story coverage is not complete. Missing for 10: MCP endpoint/connection instructions, authentication details, a documented tool list or schema, supported client compatibility, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can connect successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
